title: Link4000 Configuration
description: Configuration for Link4000, a cross-platform desktop application for managing bookmarks and file shortcuts with tagging support. Stored as TOML (usually ~/.link4000/config.toml or the path passed via --config).

links_file.description: Path to the links.json file (leave empty for default: ~/.link4000/links.json).

sharepoint_patterns.description: Regex patterns for detecting SharePoint/OneDrive URLs (matched against the full URL). SharePoint share links carry the document type as a path token instead of a file extension: :x: (Excel), :w: (Word), :p: (PowerPoint). Such links are classified as files and open in the native Office app on Windows.

exclusion_patterns.description: Regex patterns for excluding recent items from the link list. Items whose URL or path matches any pattern will be filtered out.

tray_behavior.description: Window close and minimize behavior: "close_to_tray" - X button hides to tray, minimize goes to taskbar (default); "minimize_to_tray" - minimize hides to tray, X button closes normally; "normal" - minimize to taskbar and close normally (no tray icon).

reload_interval_minutes.description: Auto-reload interval for dynamic sources in minutes (default 15). Set to 0 to disable automatic reloading. Negative values are clamped to 0.

show_tags_column.description: Show the "Tags" column in the main window (default true). When disabled, the tags are shown in the title tooltip instead.

sources.title: Source plugin configuration
sources.description: Source plugins configuration. Set enabled = false to disable a source (defaults to true). Available sources: recent_windows (recent files on Windows), recent_linux_gnome (recent files on Linux/GNOME), office_recent (recent Office documents on Windows), edge_favorites (Microsoft Edge browser favorites), edge_history (Microsoft Edge browser browsing history).

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for a source plugin: enabled and optional max_age_days.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable this source (defaults to true).

max_age_days.description: Maximum age in days for items from this source (0 = no limit).

colors.title: Link colors (light theme)
colors.description: Foreground colors per link type in light mode.

file.description: Color for file links without a configured extension color.

unknown.description: Color for links of unknown type.

colors_dark.title: Link colors (dark theme)
colors_dark.description: Dark mode colors - used automatically when the OS is in dark mode. In dark mode, [colors_dark] replaces [colors]. If a section is omitted, the light-mode defaults are used as fallback.

web.description: Color for web links in dark mode.

folder.description: Color for folder links in dark mode.

file.description: Color for file links in dark mode without a configured extension color.

sharepoint.description: Color for SharePoint/OneDrive links in dark mode.

unknown.description: Color for links of unknown type in dark mode.

extensions.title: Per-extension colors (light theme)
extensions.description: Colors for file links by file extension. Keys are extensions (lowercase, with a leading dot, e.g. ".pdf"). Explicitly configured entries take precedence over [[extension_groups]].

propertyNames.description: File extension including the leading dot (e.g. ".pdf").

additionalProperties.description: Foreground color for links with this extension.

extensions_dark.title: Per-extension colors (dark theme)
extensions_dark.description: Dark mode per-extension colors - used automatically when the OS is in dark mode. In dark mode, [extensions_dark] replaces [extensions]. Keys are extensions (lowercase, with a leading dot, e.g. ".pdf").

propertyNames.description: File extension including the leading dot (e.g. ".pdf").

additionalProperties.description: Foreground color for links with this extension in dark mode.

extension_groups.title: Extension groups
extension_groups.description: Sets of file extensions sharing a color. Group colors are used for links whose extension is not configured explicitly in the [extensions]/[extensions_dark] tables. Selected groups can also be used as filters in the "Types" section of the Filter dialog. Extensions are normalized to lowercase with a leading dot. If an extension appears in multiple groups, the first group in config order wins.

color_dark.description: Group color in dark mode (falls back to color when omitted).

extensions.description: File extensions belonging to this group (with or without a leading dot; normalized to lowercase with a leading dot).

azure_cli_path.description: Optional: override the Azure CLI executable path. Default: "az" (uses PATH lookup). Examples: "C:/Program Files/Microsoft SDKs/Azure/az.exe", "/usr/local/bin/az".
